questions_and_answers_verbatim.answer: A 等 #28 采纳后引用 (Recommended)

decisions.ITEM_1_GRANTS: all three groups: D04 16, E01 7, D02 12, cap [35, 35, 0], in one approval with one ledger. decisions.ITEM_3_LATEST_YEAR_D04: option A: the latest-year D04 positions wait until #28's D04 results are accepted and adopted, and #47 then references #28's published results; #47 sends no calls for them and imports none of #28's raw answers. Until then they are pending on #28, not on #47's own calls
decisions.ITEM_5_E01_ATTACHMENTS: E01 confirms from the item's own text only. A window whose items cannot be settled from their own text is withheld by name (HISTORICAL_E01_ITEM_TEXT_DOES_NOT_SETTLE_IT) - a correct refusal, not a delivered value; no EX-99 exhibit is requested
